vocabmatch.title: Match each word to its meaning
defs: the proof that something was done
to make a document good for more time
a written rule that every farm must follow
what is included in the audit
an official check of a farm or a company
still correct and accepted, not expired

listenings.text: When I read a certification standard, I do not look for names. I look for actions. The rules are always written in the same way. Records are kept for three years. Evidence is requested for every criterion. The farm is audited every twelve months. Nobody says who does the work, because the action is the important part. After my last visit, the report was sent to Geneva and the farm was approved. The certificate was renewed for one more year.

Hi Carlos, this is Emma. Three quick points about the new standard. First, the scope: this year only the coffee area is audited, not the whole property. Second, the evidence: every document is checked, so please keep the original papers. Third, one date: the audit is scheduled for June fifteenth, and the certificate is renewed in July. Your evidence folder was received this morning. Thank you, Carlos. Talk soon.

extra_audio.text: First, the standard: the new rules are published in June. Then the evidence: every document is requested and checked. Next, the audit: the farm is audited by an external team. After that, the result: the report was sent to Geneva and the farm was approved. Finally, the certificate: the certificate is renewed for one more year.
